reason: Effective School Solutions is a PE-backed (Frazier Healthcare Partners) B2B vendor that sells in-school mental-health clinical programs INTO 140+ public school districts across 9+ states (~321 employees, ~$13.4M revenue, HQ New Providence, NJ) -- it is not an independent or charter school with a board of trustees and tuition-paying families, so Kenneth Thomas's enrollment-attrition EDP does not apply; structurally ESS is the kind of outside vendor his clients would be governing, not the buyer. Every one of the ~30 roles in today's fresh ATS feed is a clinician, therapist, mental health technician, or PD trainer -- there is no IT, security, technology-director, or vendor-governance posting anywhere in the list, and the three matched jobs scored ~0.30 on generic JD lexicon alone (strong_title=False, gap=False). No live posting contains a quotable line that redescribes the technology-governance pain he fixes.
